methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

BEAR.desc: EPS -46.3%/yr (worst year FY11-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.0%/yr (Q3 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 median

BULL.desc: EPS +7.0%/yr (FY11-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +48.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2022-01-21) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.59x (76.4% downside to Bear $15 / +47.9% upside to Bull $94) | Adj composite 3.10 vs market 2.18: gap +0.92 [UNDERVALUED] | +10% above the EPP floor $58 (21x FY21E $2.75) | Conservative 2-yr case: +30.6% total (+15.3%/yr) | At 23.1x FY21E the 15% hurdle price $84 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; U.S. revenues +11.5% in Q3 2021, forward revenues +10% (no FY21 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2021 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
